cohort: Neonates born at 35 weeks gestational age or later who were admitted to the NICU with respiratory distress requiring support at Al Wakra Hospital, Qatar, between January and December 2022.
finding: Respiratory distress is a common cause of NICU admission among neonates with a gestational age of >= 35 weeks (8.6%), with its incidence highest at 35 weeks, progressively declining up to 39 weeks, and then increasing.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery and instrument use were significant predictors for respiratory distress among neonates.
